info.name: ribbon-health Cost Estimates Reference Endpoints API

params.name: search
params.description: String input that fuzzy searches across `display_name`, `carrier_name`, and `uuid`.

params.name: carrier_association
params.description:
Comma separated list of the carrier association of insurances you are searching for.

Note: This input must be an exact string match to work

params.name: carrier_brand
params.description:
Comma separated list of the carrier brand of insurances you are searching for.

Note: This input must be an exact string match to work

params.name: carrier_name
params.value: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Illinois
params.description:
Comma separated list of the carrier name of insurances you are searching for.

Note: This input must be an exact string match to work

params.name: state
params.description: Two letter abbreviated state code of insurances you are searching for.

params.name: plan_name
params.description: Exact string input of the plan name of insurances you are searching for.

params.name: plan_type
params.description: Exact string input of the plan type of insurances you are searching for.

params.name: display_name
params.value: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Illinois - BlueCare Direct - HMO
params.description: Exact string input of the display name of insurances you are searching for.

params.name: category
params.description:
Comma separated list of the category of insurances you are searching for.

Note: This input must be an exact string match to work

params.name: _excl_category
params.description:
Comma separated list of the category of insurances you wish to exclude.

Note: This input must be an exact string match to work

params.name: codes
params.description: Single code input to search for plans with an exact string match within the codes field.

params.name: partial_codes
params.description:
Partial string input to match to the codes field.
For Medicare Advantage plans this is a contract ID (i.e. H9572). For Federal or State Exchange plans this is the first 10 digits of the HIOS ID (i.e. 36096il100)

Note: This parameter can only be used if the `category` param is also utilized with a single category value.
